integrity: The general claims follow from an explicit proof. Reproducibility code supplies supplementary finite checks. Priority remains subject to independent literature review.
scientific_limitations: Unit-diagonal strictly lower-triangular factors, exact arithmetic, and a fixed row budget strictly between zero and one; the operator-norm assertion is asymptotic, not a finite-dimensional exact maximum formula. The result does not cover an entire ILU preconditioner or assert convergence of a solver.
title: Sharp mixed-norm amplification for row-dominant triangular inverses
